name: fem loads: an 80 × 40 × 10 steel plate with a 12 mm hole (sketch + extrude: a true cylindrical hole)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [80, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 0], b: [80, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 40], b: [0, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, 40], b: [0, 0] }, { kind: 'circle', c: [20, 20], r: 6 }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 10 })); }); await sleep(1200); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, cyl: m.state.partEntry.faces.filter((f) => /CYL/.test(f.geomType)).length }); })()

name: connectors: the page offers six kinds; a spring between the hole and the end face is picked, added and run — its force is listed
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const e = m.state.editing; const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const hole = all.find((x) => /CYL/.test(x.f.geomType)); const end = all.find((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE' && Math.abs(x.f.center.x - 80) < 1e-6); const start = all.find((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE' && Math.abs(x.f.center.x) < 1e-6); const kinds = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-set="fem.connType"]')].map((b) => b.dataset.value); m.actions.pmSet('fem.connType', 'spring'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('conn.axial', '2000'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('conn.shear', '2000'); const fem = m.sim2 ? null : null; m.viewport; const pickFace = (x) => m.actions.pick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: 'body', index: x.index, point: [x.f.center.x, x.f.center.y, x.f.center.z] }, {}); pickFace(hole); await sleep(50); pickFace(end); await sleep(50); await m.actions.pmCommand('fem.connAdd'); e.fixtures = [{ index: start.index, faceId: start.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE', kind: 'fixed' }]; e.loads = [{ index: end.index, faceId: end.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }]; e.loadKind = 'force'; e.magnitude = 500; e.dir = '-z'; e.elementSize = 3; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !e.result; i++) await sleep(150); await sleep(200); return JSON.stringify({ kinds: kinds.length, added: e.connectors.length, type: e.connectors[0]?.type, result: e.result?.connectors?.length, table: [...document.querySelectorAll('.sim2-table td')].some((td) => /N/.test(td.textContent)) }); })()
